rules.aim_state: Select pose continuously from allowed aim direction, independent of firing.
rules.airborne: Use airborne stance during both rising and falling; these are holds, not a jump animation cycle.
rules.landing: Evaluate grounded weapon permissions before selecting pose; no grounded down pose is supplied.
rules.mirror: Reflect layer composition and all anchor coordinates around x=64. Left maps from right; down-left maps from down-right.
rules.registration: Map logical [64,104] to collision feet; source crops must not be autoscaled by opaque bounds.
rules.muzzle: Logical post-transform positions; projectiles and effects use these anchors with aim direction.
rules.rotation: Clockwise degrees in y-down coordinates, about per-layer logical pivot before drawing destination.
rules.recoil: No recoil frames supplied; firing should not gate pose selection.
